title: Opinion: Opinion | Sonia Gandhi, And The Weight Of The Things Left Unsaid
summary_full: "You must know, Sonia beti, that in this country it is not what you are that counts, it is what people think you to be," someone said to Sonia Gandhi when she first arrived in India. Decades later, she tries to bridge the gap between what she is and what people have always thought her to be.
